descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
iSoftStone is seeking a Mobile Test Engineer to join our team in Romania!
 Responsibilities: 
 1. Independently complete the localization test in the region
 2. Complete test cases provided from the R&D team and send back reliable test results
 3. Cooperate with R&D to resolve problems that occur during the test cases
 4. Cooperate with R&D to debug and catch valid Log information
 5. On-site support for users to resolve regional problems
 6. In charge of design and optimization for local specific cases
 Qualifications: 
 1. Skilled communication in English and local language
 2. Knowledge about local mobile network providers
 3. Familiar with Android system and basic test methods
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 1. Skilled use of ADB, QXDM or other Debug tools is preferred
 2. Experience in relevant mobile phone localization testing is preferred
 3. Ability to communicate in Chinese is preferred
